name: Innerlog
source:
We all have our inner dialogues, only some of us are lucky to find someone else to share it with. Follow Ai Vy as she finds that one special person in Keshi.

[From [url=https://jennyvipham.itch.io/innerlog]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我们都有自己的内心对话，只有我们中的一些人幸运地找到其他人来分享。跟随Ai Vy，她会在Keshi找到一位特别的人。

[来自[url=https://jennyvipham.itch.io/innerlog]itch.io[/url]]
